description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for managing workflow modules within the SuiteCRM platform, including functions for retrieving module fields, related modules, relationships, generating dropdown lists, and formatting data for display and processing.

methods.name: getModuleFields
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module fields, with optional filters and restrictions, for use in forms or data processing.

methods.name: getRelModuleFields
methods.description: Retrieves fields from a related module based on a relationship field.

methods.name: getRelatedModule
methods.description: Determines the related module name based on a module and relationship link fields.

methods.name: getModuleTreeData
methods.description: Builds a JSON structure representing module and its linked relationships for a hierarchical view.

methods.name: getModuleRelationships
methods.description: Returns a list of relationships and linked modules for a given module.

methods.name: getValidFieldsTypes
methods.description: Returns acceptable data types for a specific field within a module, based on its field definition.

methods.name: getModuleField
methods.description: Generates the HTML or display output for a specific module's field, incorporating logic for different field types, formatting, and rendering templates.

methods.name: createBracketVariableAlias
methods.description: Converts a bracketed variable string into a simplified alias suitable for JS variable names.

methods.name: getDateField
methods.description: Creates a date-related input control or display string based on module and field definitions.

methods.name: getDateFields
methods.description: Returns a list of date-related fields for a module, optionally formatted for display.

methods.name: getAssignField
methods.description: Constructs an assignation selector field with options for user roles, security groups, or other assignable types.

methods.name: getDropdownList
methods.description: Generates HTML option tags for a dropdown list based on a list ID and selected value.

methods.name: getLeastBusyUser
methods.description: Selects the user with the fewest assigned items based on a database query.

methods.name: getRoundRobinUser
methods.description: Selects the next user in a round-robin sequence, considering session and cache storage.

methods.name: setLastUser
methods.description: Stores the last user selected in a cache file for round-robin user assignment.

methods.name: getEmailableModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules with email addresses that are suitable for mailing based on bean classes.

methods.name: getRelatedEmailableFields
methods.description: Finds email fields related to a given module that are suitable for email communication.

methods.name: fixUpFormatting
methods.description: Adjusts a field value according to its field type, converting dates, times, numerics, or booleans into proper formats.
